summary:
Reviewed w121's commits 3593951 and 82ad81f, rebased copies of 975b45d and 5652908 with the same content.
In one process the change meets r56, r64 and r65. The deprecated scenario is retired with its binding. No test was weakened, both allowances hold, and lint and size are clean.
Important, fix now: under -n auto (work run's own work-item test command where xdist is installed) a guarantees-only run left with no test still exits 5. GUARANTEES is set only in the xdist workers' collection hook, and the controller decides the exit. Probe: -n 2 gave exit 5, serial gave exit 0. So such a work-item cannot merge.
Observations: an empty or unparsable accepts: now deselects everything and exits 0 (it used to be refused). test_supervision.py was edited outside the fileset, as the person's answer asked.
questions: Important, scripts/work_items.py:112-113,128-131: r65's success exit relies on a stash set during collection, which runs only in xdist workers, so `pytest -n auto --work-item <guarantees-only>` still exits 5 and work run's merge check fails it.
